options.title: Precompute frame word 0 so s_valid rises with start
options.approach: In tx_frame_src, precompute word 0 and the s_valid enable from the configuration, which is the only input word 0 depends on. s_valid then rises on the same clock as start instead of one clock later (stage fs_start). The MAC, PCS, the IP and UDP checksum logic and the receive side are not changed.

gain.basis_note: fs_start adds 1 clock and the stage file allows at most 1 to come out. The low end is 0 because the worst path (0.115 ns slack) ends in frame_src and could limit the clock if the change lengthens it.
gain.ceiling_basis: the removable clocks of the touched stages, per the stage file (1)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: A small RTL change, but it needs a bench run, a route and a check that the worst path in frame_src still meets timing.
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); wall time is those times the recorded Vivado run

options.title: Shorten the go-pulse crossing by one flop stage
options.approach: In core, shorten the xpm_cdc_pulse u_p_go crossing from the rx clock to the tx clock by one clock (for example by dropping the output register after edge detect). The quasi-static order bus crossing, the receive and transmit paths, and frame_src's 4-clock sampling of the order bus are not changed, though the sampling delay would have to be checked against the earlier pulse.

gain.basis_note: cross_go adds 4 clocks and the stage file allows at most 1 to come out. The low end is 0 because the change may be rejected if the order bus is not settled when the earlier pulse arrives.
gain.ceiling_basis: the removable clocks of the touched stages, per the stage file (1)

risk.contract_note: The change is inside core and no port moves, but frame_src reads the order bus 4 clocks after the pulse, so the pulse timing is a hidden dependency.

options.title: Transmit-side start: precompute word 0 and merge the MAC preamble register
options.approach: Take O1's precompute of word 0 in tx_frame_src. Also let tx_mac load the preamble word in the clock that s_valid rises, merging the mac_preamble register stage into the start path, since the preamble does not depend on frame data. The PCS encode register (tx_encode), the gearbox spill and the receive side are not changed.

gain.basis_note: The stage file allows 1 clock from fs_start and 1 from mac_preamble, so at most 2. The low end is 0 because the 0.115 ns worst path and the 1.132 ns slack of mac_preamble may limit the clock.
gain.ceiling_basis: the removable clocks of the touched stages, per the stage file (2)

options.title: Whole-design ladder: transmit start, go crossing and decision register
options.approach: Start from O3 (fs_start and mac_preamble). Add the O2 shortening of the cross_go crossing in core. Also remove the decision register in trade_decision, so the price compare and the arm/kill/enable interlock feed the crossing flop directly (stage decide). The receive PCS and MAC stages, the tx_encode register and the gearbox spill are not changed.

gain.basis_note: The stage file allows 1 clock from each of the four stages, so at most 4 of the 11 clocks (latency.total_clocks). The low end is 0 because any one of the changes may fail timing or the CDC checks.
gain.ceiling_basis: the removable clocks of the touched stages, per the stage file (4)
